Title: ContactViewModel Model
Summary: Data model for contact form submissions with DataAnnotations validation rules.
Content:
## ContactViewModel

**Namespace:** `MyBlazorApp.Models`

**Type:** `public class`

### Properties

| Property | Type | Validation | Description |
|----------|------|------------|-------------|
| `Name` | `string` | `[Required]`, `[StringLength(100)]` | Full name of the contact. |
| `Email` | `string` | `[Required]`, `[EmailAddress]`, `[StringLength(200)]` | Email address for reply. |
| `Subject` | `string` | `[Required]`, `[StringLength(150)]` | Subject line of the message. |
| `Message` | `string` | `[Required]`, `[StringLength(2000)]` | Body of the message. |

### Validation Rules

| Field | Rule | Error Message |
|-------|------|---------------|
| Name | Required, max 100 chars | "Name is required." / "Name cannot exceed 100 characters." |
| Email | Required, valid email, max 200 chars | "Email is required." / "Invalid email address." / "Email cannot exceed 200 characters." |
| Subject | Required, max 150 chars | "Subject is required." / "Subject cannot exceed 150 characters." |
| Message | Required, max 2000 chars | "Message is required." / "Message cannot exceed 2000 characters." |

### Default Values

All string properties initialize to `string.Empty` to avoid null reference issues in Blazor form binding.

### Usage

```razor
<EditForm Model="contact" OnValidSubmit="HandleSubmit">
    <DataAnnotationsValidator />
    <ValidationSummary />

    <InputText @bind-Value="contact.Name" />
    <InputText @bind-Value="contact.Email" />
    <InputText @bind-Value="contact.Subject" />
    <InputTextArea @bind-Value="contact.Message" />

    <button type="submit">Send</button>
</EditForm>

@code {
    private ContactViewModel contact = new();

    private void HandleSubmit()
    {
        // Process validated contact form
    }
}
```

### Notes

- Designed for use with Blazor's `EditForm` and `DataAnnotationsValidator`.
- All properties are non-nullable strings initialized to `string.Empty`.
- No service layer integration yet — this is a pure data/validation model.
